Boston housing prices dataset

boston_housing.Rd

Median housing values and associated predictors for Boston suburbs. This dataset is sourced from the MASS package.

Usage

data(boston_housing, package = "heteroTests")

Format

A data frame with 506 rows and 14 variables as described in ?MASS::Boston.

Source

MASS package.

Examples

data(boston_housing)
head(boston_housing)
